scripts.prepare: bun run sync && bun lefthook install
scripts.check: bun run check:lint && bun run --filter=* check && bun run check:format
scripts.fix: bun run fix:lint && bun run fix:format
scripts.tidy: bun run fix && bun run check
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/server && bun run drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/server && bun run drizzle-kit migrate
